import qualified Data.IntMap.Strict as Map
import Data.List (foldl')

main :: IO ()
main = do
  contents <- getContents
  let allNums = map read (words contents) :: [Int]
  case allNums of
    (n:m:rest) -> do
      let adj = foldl' addEdge (Map.empty) (pairs rest)
          pairs (a:b:xs) = (a,b) : pairs xs
          pairs _ = []
          addEdge g (a,b) = Map.insertWith (++) a [b] (Map.insertWith (++) b [a] g)
          start = Set.singleton 1
          dist1 = Map.fromList [(1, 0)]
          bfs = go [1] adj Map.empty
          go [] _ d = d
          go (c:cs) g d = go cs' g d'

              nbrs = Map.findWithDefault [] c g

          dists = bfs (Map.singleton 1 0)
          ans = length [ v | (v, dv) <- Map.toList dists, dv == 1 || dv == 2 ]
      print ans

    _ = ()
